caseName: Colorado & Northwestern Railroad v. United States
caseNameFull: Colorado & Northwestern Railroad Company, in Error v. United States
summary: In error to the District Court of the United States for the District of Colorado.
attorneys: Mr. E. E. Whitted for the plaintiff in error., The Attorney General, Mr. Assistant to the Attorney General Fowler and Mr. Henry E. Colton for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Union Trust Co. of St. Louis v. Westhus, 228 U. S. 519. (See United States v. The Colorado & N. W. R. R. Co., 157 Fed. Rep. 321; S. C., 209 U. S. 544.)
